items.title: 🛠️ Thoreau BASIC – What if BASIC hadn't gone out of fashion?SummaryThoreau BASIC is a free x64 BASIC interpreter inspired by GW-BASIC that runs as a Windows program or directly on bare-metal UEFI. It features native JIT compilation, multithreading, SIMD acceleration, 64-bit addressing, and TCP/IP networking.Why it’s interestingIt combines retro BASIC syntax like line numbers and GOTO with modern high-performance features like AVX2, JIT compilation, and bare-metal UEFI execution.Source metrics: Points 10 · Comments 5HN discussion · ProjectSource: #HackerNews / Show HN
items.content_html:
🛠️ Thoreau BASIC – What if BASIC hadn't gone out of fashion?

Summary
Thoreau BASIC is a free x64 BASIC interpreter inspired by GW-BASIC that runs as a Windows program or directly on bare-metal UEFI. It features native JIT compilation, multithreading, SIMD acceleration, 64-bit addressing, and TCP/IP networking.

Why it’s interesting
It combines retro BASIC syntax like line numbers and GOTO with modern high-performance features like AVX2, JIT compilation, and bare-metal UEFI execution.
